gap: No result ChatGPT got states that SoundGuys measured the Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro's ANC cutting low-frequency noise by about 30 dB but lasting only 5 h 42 min with ANC on, while open-ear models showed almost no isolation to measure and ran 9 h (AeroFit 2, HeadphoneCheck, high volume) to 13 h 1 min (Bose Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen, SoundGuys) per charge.
standout_why: ChatGPT ran an empty search and got no results, so there were no cited or top-ranked rival pages to compare against. Its answer is a table of adjectives ('Noise cancellation: Often excellent / Usually none', 'Long-term comfort: Often better') with no figures, no lab and no battery data. It tells 6–8 h/day users to buy open-ear but gives no runtime to back that up. Our current page lists only maker battery claims and has no measured isolation or runtime.
decides: The figures support ChatGPT's split with numbers. For noise (subway, plane), the sealed ANC earbud is the only option that measurably blocks sound: about 30 dB at low frequencies per SoundGuys, against roughly 0 dB through the midrange on the AeroFit 2. For an 8-hour wear day, the measured runtimes favor open-ear. SoundGuys got 5 h 42 min from the Liberty 4 Pro with ANC on, short of a workday, while HeadphoneCheck got 9 h from the AeroFit 2 and SoundGuys got 13 h 1 min from the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds 2nd Gen. The labs and test conditions differ, so this shows direction rather than a head-to-head result. Separately, our page's Bose row describes the 1st gen (7.5 h). SoundGuys reviewed a 2nd Gen released 2026-10-02 at $299 (IPX4), so that row should be updated.

findings.label: ANC low-frequency noise reduction (SoundGuys lab)
findings.source_title: Anker Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro review – SoundGuys (Chase Bernath)
findings.note: Quote: 'Our testing shows that the ANC reduces low-frequency noise, such as the rumble of an airplane engine, by about 30dB.' Lab ANC score 8.1/10. Review dated Oct 16, 2024.

findings.label: Battery per charge, ANC on (SoundGuys standardized test)
findings.source_title: Anker Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro review – SoundGuys (Chase Bernath)
findings.note: 'lasted 5 hours and 42 minutes with ANC enabled.' Anker claims 30 h with ANC / 40 h without, including the case. Oct 16, 2024.

findings.label: Battery per charge, HeadphoneCheck test
findings.value: 10 h standard mode at high volume (AAC); 6.5 h at maximum ANC; 40 h / 26 h total with case
findings.source_title: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro by Anker – HeadphoneCheck (Maike Paeßens)
findings.note: Page last updated 12.12.2024. 5-min quick charge gives 3 h 15 min (ANC off). Earbuds weigh 5.5 g each.

findings.label: Battery per charge, HeadphoneCheck test
findings.value: 9 h at high volume (AAC); 41 h 30 min total with case
findings.source_title: Soundcore AeroFit 2 by Anker – HeadphoneCheck (Maike Paeßens)
findings.note: Maker claims 10 h / 42 h. 10-min quick charge gives 4 h 15 min. 10 g per bud. Last updated 22.10.2024.

findings.label: Passive isolation (SoundGuys attenuation chart)
findings.value: about 0 dB through most of the midrange; peaks of 10.4 dB at 6,130 Hz and 6.2 dB at 9,720 Hz; 4.6 dB at 21 Hz
findings.source_title: Soundcore AeroFit 2 – SoundGuys product page (Dave Carr, Oct 2024)
findings.note: Values read from the product page's lab chart. The review text (https://www.soundguys.com/anker-soundcore-aerofit-2-review-126119) says the earbuds 'do not block out any noise'. SoundGuys rates them 5.3/10, 'Not recommended'.

findings.label: Battery per charge (SoundGuys standardized test)
findings.value: 13 h 1 min (rated 9 h); 28.5 h total with case
findings.source_title: Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) review – SoundGuys (Adam Birney)
findings.note: Published Oct 7, 2026; release date given as Oct 2, 2026. Runtime drops with Immersive Audio or Auto Volume on (Bose rates about 5 h). Review notes 'barely any isolation for us to measure'. IPX4; $299 list price at review.

findings.label: Battery per charge (SoundGuys testing)
findings.note: 'up to 11 hours on a single charge in our testing'. Test conditions not stated, and the figure matches the maker's claim. Isolation was editor-scored (3.0), not measured. Published Mar 12, 2025.
